title: Sr. Bioinformatics Scientist
description:
ABOUT SINGULAR GENOMICS

Singular Genomics is inventing at the forefront of genomics, one of the world’s fastest-growing industries. The commercially available G4® Sequencing Platform is a powerful, highly versatile benchtop genomic sequencer designed to produce fast and accurate results. In addition, the company is currently developing the G4X™ Spatial Sequencer, an upgrade to the G4, which will leverage Singular’s proprietary sequencing technology, applying it as an in situ readout for transcriptomics, proteomics and fluorescent H&E in tissue, with spatial context. Singular Genomics’ mission is to empower researchers and clinicians to advance science and medicine.

We foster a culture of creativity and technical excellence, both catalysts for innovation. We celebrate diversity, emphasize collaboration and, as we rapidly mature, we are constantly looking at ways we can do better for our people.

Our Headquarters are located on the Torrey Pines Mesa, in La Jolla, California at the center of the biotech hub. Our Manufacturing facility is in Sorrento Valley.

 

Position Summary:

As a Senior Scientist on the Bioinformatics team, you will play a key role in expanding Singular Genomics' spatial biology platform and service offerings. This position sits at the intersection of computational biology, assay development, and hands-on scientific computing. You will report into the Bioinformatics functional group and, initially, be matrixed into the Panel Design team to focus on its most pressing needs. Your initial focus will be supporting the design and optimization of targeted in situ transcriptomics panels for tissue- and disease-specific applications. This includes selecting biologically informative genes for cell type identification, defining pathway-focused content that enables cell-state interpretation, and developing computational tools to automate and improve panel design. As the platform and services continue to evolve, you will contribute to the development of spatial bioinformatics workflows, analysis pipelines, and computational methods that enable customers to generate meaningful biological insight from spatial multiomics data. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys applying computational approaches to challenging biological problems while building software that directly impacts cutting-edge products and services. This position can be remote or hybrid/on-site. If remote, travel to the headquarters in San Diego, CA will be required at least quarterly.

Responsibilities:

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Support the computational design and optimization of targeted spatial transcriptomics panels for tissue- and disease-specific applications.
  • Define biologically relevant panel content by integrating current literature, public datasets, and pathway knowledge to support cell type annotation and cell state characterization.
  • Develop computational methods and software tools for automated panel design, probe evaluation, and panel optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with molecular biology, chemistry, and assay development teams to iteratively improve probe performance and panel quality.
  • Evaluate panel performance using internal datasets and external spatial and single-cell reference atlases.

Spatial Bioinformatics

  • Develop and maintain analysis pipelines for spatial transcriptomics and spatial multiomics datasets.
  • Apply modern spatial bioinformatics methods to support sequencer / assay development and biological interpretation, including cell typing, differential expression, pathway analysis, spatial neighborhood analysis, and cell-state characterization.
  • Work with scientists across R&D to develop new analysis capabilities that support expanding service offerings.
  • Stay current with advances in spatial biology, single-cell genomics, and computational biology, incorporating new approaches where appropriate.

Scientific Software & Automation

  • Write clear, workable code (primarily Python) to automate panel design, analysis, and other repetitive scientific tasks.
  • Build and maintain automated analysis workflows that make routine spatial and single-cell analyses repeatable and easy to run. 

Qualifications:

  • PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Candidates with an MS plus industry experience will also be considered.
  • Experience analyzing spatial transcriptomics, single-cell sequencing, or related genomics datasets.
  • Strong understanding of tissue biology, cell type annotation, and pathway-based biological interpretation.
  • Proficiency writing analysis code in Python; able to produce clear, workable code without requiring production-software polish.
  • Experience building automated analysis workflows or pipelines. • Working knowledge of Linux-based computational environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing targeted sequencing or hybridization-based panels.
  • Experience with probe design, oligonucleotide design, or molecular assay development.
  • Experience with single-cell analysis frameworks such as Scanpy, Squidpy, Seurat, or similar.
  • Knowledge of cancer biology, immunology, or tissue-specific biology.
  • Experience developing workflow pipelines using Nextflow.
  • Familiarity with containerization (e.g., Docker) and reproducible-environment tooling.
  • Software-engineering rigor (testing, CI/CD, packaging) is welcome but not expected at this level.
  • Experience with cloud computing environments (AWS preferred). • Familiarity with image-based spatial technologies or microscopy data.
  • Experience with primary analysis methods such as image processing, feature detection, registration, or sequencing base calling is a plus but not required..

 

The estimated base salary range for this role based in the United States of America is: $131,600 - $154,800. Additionally, this role is eligible for to receive equity as part of the compensation package. Compensation decisions are dependent on several factors including, but not limited to, an individual’s qualifications, location where the role is to be performed, internal equity, and alignment with market data. Should the level of the role change during the hiring process, the applicable salary range may be updated accordingly.

 

Singular Genomics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

 

Singular Genomics is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants with a disability who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process can provide their name and contact information to our Accommodations team at accommodationsrequest@singulargenomics.com. Your request will be responded to as soon as possible.

title: Forward Deployed Computational Biologist
description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Please submit your CV in English Salary range: $128,000 - $150,000 About the role: We are seeking a Forward Deployed Computational Biologist to operate at the intersection of AI, software systems, and biology. In this role, you will work directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions for complex scientific problems as part of Owkin’s agentic platform, K Pro, to fully meet specific customer needs. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. You will spend time at the customer’s premises, turning ambiguous scientific challenges—such as discovering novel drug targets or disease subtypes—into reliable and scalable agentic solutions. You will be responsible for both the scientific rigor of the analytical workflows and the technical robustness of their implementation and deployment, bridging the gap between science and real-world application. Proven expertise and impact in analyzing complex data, such as real-world clinical data and multimodal omics (e.g, bulk, spatial/single-cell, proteomics) and high-throughput experimental data. Strong familiarity with coding agents. AI/ML Experience : Familiarity with machine learning concepts (e.g., cross-validation, statistical tests) and frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.). Experience with LLMs and agentic AI frameworks is a plus. Communication : Exceptional ability to translate scientific complexity for non-technical internal and external stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to write production-level code in deployed products. #LI-MD1 What we offer Flexible work organization Friendly and informal working environment Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds Recruitment Process & Security Please complete the form and submit your CV. title: Research Associate II, Pluvinage Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking a Research Associate to join the Pluvinage Lab at the Arc Institute. Our goal is to improve the lives of patients with neurological diseases. We do this by exploring undiagnosed autoimmunity in rare mystery cases and common neurodegenerative conditions alike. Starting with clinical observations and primary patient tissue, we use functional genomics, protein display technologies, and computational tools to embark on deep mechanistic dives into the contribution of autoimmunity to cognitive function. Your work will have the potential to uncover novel autoantibodies that drive cognitive decline in autoimmune encephalitis, that modulate cognitive decline in dementia, and that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging.

The questions we ask:

  1. How do autoantibodies regulate cognition?
  2. What is the source, target, and mechanism of pathogenic autoantibodies in neurological disease?
  3. How can we eliminate pathogenic autoantibodies while leaving the rest of the immune system intact?
  4. How does comorbid autoimmunity contribute to cognitive decline in neurodegeneration?
  5. Are there protective autoantibodies that promote cognitive resilience in healthy brain aging?

The approaches we take: discovery-driven projects starting with human samples (cerebrospinal fluid, PBMCs, brain tissue) from curated cohorts of patients with neurological diseases, CRISPR screens, phage display, immune repertoire sequencing.

In this role, you will work closely with senior lab members to drive high-throughput antibody discovery in autoimmune neurology and neurodegeneration. You will contribute across the full experimental workflow: designing constructs and libraries, cloning and validating reagents, executing screens across several protein display technologies, and analyzing and validating discoveries. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys both the precision of molecular biology and the challenge of making complex discovery workflows reproducible and scalable. Your work will help advance new diagnostic approaches from bench to bedside.

About you

  • You are detail-oriented and rigorous, taking pride in well-designed experiments, reliable reagents, and reproducible results.
  • You are curious and self-motivated, with a strong foundation in molecular biology and an eagerness to learn new protein display and antibody discovery technologies.
  • You enjoy working across an entire experimental workflow, from sequence design and cloning to screening and data analysis.
  • You are organized and able to manage multiple experiments while maintaining careful sample tracking and documentation.
  • You collaborate closely with others, communicate results and challenges openly, and troubleshoot thoughtfully.
  • You are passionate about translating discoveries into better diagnostics for patients with neurological disease.
  • This position is designed as a training role for individuals preparing to apply to a PhD program. The work associated with this role is expected to last approximately two years, giving you time to build a portfolio of research to support future applications.

In this position you will

  • Build Discovery Reagents: Work with senior lab members to design DNA constructs and protein display libraries; perform molecular cloning, sequence verification, and quality control of constructs and libraries.
  • Execute High-Throughput Screens: Prepare reagents and patient samples, carry out antibody discovery and antigen-identification workflows across multiple protein display platforms, and maintain rigorous controls and sample tracking throughout.
  • Analyze and Validate Discoveries: Process screening data using established analysis workflows, assess data quality and reproducibility, and work with senior lab members to prioritize hits and validate antibody–antigen interactions using complementary assays.
  • Develop and Optimize Workflows: Work with senior lab members to troubleshoot experiments, compare assay conditions, and help improve the sensitivity, specificity, throughput, and reproducibility of discovery methods.
  • Maintain Research Quality: Keep complete experimental records, document protocols and analysis steps, and maintain organized inventories of samples, constructs, libraries, and reagents.
  • Contribute to a Collaborative Lab: Communicate progress at lab meetings, coordinate experiments with senior lab members and collaborators, and contribute to shared lab operations, equipment maintenance, and protocol training.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, bioengineering, immunology, genetics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant laboratory experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in an academic or industry setting (including independent lab work during your undergraduate studies).
  • Hands-on research experience in molecular biology
  • Demonstrated ability to execute multistep experimental protocols accurately, use appropriate controls, and maintain clear and complete laboratory records.
  • Growth mindset to stretch your scientific skillset in a supportive environment, and the awareness to know when to ask for help.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills, including careful tracking of samples, reagents, and experimental conditions.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work both independently on established workflows and collaboratively with senior scientists.
  • Commitment to rigorous, reproducible research and a strong interest in antibody discovery and its diagnostic applications.

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

Parse Biosciences, a QIAGEN company, is a global life sciences company whose mission is to accelerate progress in human health and scientific research. Empowering researchers to perform single cell sequencing with unprecedented scale and ease, its pioneering approach has enabled groundbreaking discoveries in cancer treatment, tissue repair, stem cell therapy, kidney and liver disease, brain development, and the immune system.

With technology developed at The University of Washington, Parse has raised over $100 million in capital and is now used by over 3.000 customers across the world. Our growing portfolio of products includes Evercode Whole Transcriptome, Evercode TCR, BCR, Gene Capture, and Trailmaker, our data analysis solution.

Parse Biosciences is based in Seattle, Washington's vibrant South Lake Union district, where we recently opened a 34,000 square foot headquarters and state-of-the-art laboratory.

You will be expected to create and execute a sales strategy across academic, biotech, and pharmaceutical accounts while working closely with Field Application Scientists and other Parse team members. Candidates should have strong technical skills, sales skills, the ability to develop and manage customer relationships, and a drive to overachieve. Gaining a deep understanding of the single cell market and Parse’s products will be critical to success.  You will accelerate growth in both named Key Accounts and select territories across the United States.  You will act as a specialist to move an emerging segment faster than one rep can on their own.

description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY KIDS

Khan Academy Kids is a free and fun learning program for children ages 2 to 8. Kodi Bear and a cast of animated characters lead children on a personalized education journey filled with fun, standards-aligned activities in early literacy, math, executive functioning and social emotional skills. Built by a small but mighty team, Khan Academy Kids is used by millions of children in homes and classrooms around the world. 

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy Kids is looking for an early childhood educator and learning-content developer to build and strengthen learning activities and assessments for children in PreK through 2nd grade.

Working on a small, interdisciplinary team alongside product managers, engineers, designers, and academic experts, the Content Creator will identify gaps in our content library, create and revise learning experiences in English and Spanish, and improve the systems that support content development. Content spans bilingual (English and Spanish) learning activities and direct assessments across early literacy, language, math, and executive function.

We are looking for someone who understands how young children learn, is energized by using data to make content better, and cares deeply about making early learning both rigorous and fun.

title: People Operations Coordinator
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

This role sits on the People Operations team and is the face of the team for many of the employees at Arc. From onboarding to programs and partnering with the people across the organization, you’ll have the opportunity to work as part of a high performing team and learn the full HR stack. You will own the new hire and departing employee experience, and support immigration and payroll operations. This position provides practical experience and is a training ground for many different types of roles in the people domain. This is 5 days a week onsite position in Palo Alto.

  • Maintain accurate employee records in our HRIS and related systems, and audit data with the People Operations team.

description:
Our Mission

Our mission is to restore cell health and resilience through cell rejuvenation to reverse disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life.

For more information, see our website at altoslabs.com.

Our Value

Our Single Altos Value: Everyone Owns Achieving Our Inspiring Mission.

Diversity at Altos

Altos Labs has been named one of the Top 3 Biotech Companies and ranked for the second year on the Forbes 2026 Best Startups in America list.  At Altos, exceptional scientists and industry leaders from around the world work together to advance a shared mission. Our intentional focus is on Belonging, so that all employees know that they are valued for their unique perspectives. We are all accountable for sustaining a diverse and inclusive environment.

What You Will Contribute To Altos

 

Join Altos Labs at the Bay Area Discovery Science center and play a pivotal role in our mission to reverse brain aging. We are seeking a driven neuroscientist with deep expertise in neurodegeneration to join our highly collaborative, fast-paced team. In this role, you will work closely with cross-functional experts to discover and validate optimal therapeutic targets for the treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. If you are passionate about translating complex biology into transformative therapies, we want you on our team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Science: Act as the scientific lead for a key segment of our neurodegeneration portfolio. You will shape critical research questions, design robust experiments, and drive studies through to actionable, interpretable conclusions.
  • Model Disease Biology: Design and execute in vivo studies using rodent models of neurodegeneration, strategically selecting models, timepoints, and endpoints tailored to specific biological questions and program stages.
  • Analyze Complex Tissue: Process and analyze both rodent and human brain tissue. This includes dissection, regional sampling, fixation, cryopreservation, sectioning, and comprehensive downstream characterization (molecular, biochemical, and histological).
  • Innovate Quantitative Readouts: Develop and apply precise quantitative readouts for pathology and disease biology, tracking markers such as protein aggregation, neuroinflammation, cell loss, and vascular integrity.
  • Collaborate Across Disciplines: Partner closely with internal experts—including in vivo pharmacology, histology, molecular biology, computational, and program management teams—as well as external collaborators and CROs to seamlessly deliver on shared timelines.
  • Champion Scientific Rigor: Establish and promote the highest technical and cultural standards across our scientific functions. You will help embed foundational practices—such as experimental rigor, blinding, randomization, data provenance, and reproducibility—into our day-to-day operations.
  • Drive Strategic Decisions: Actively contribute to program strategy and high-level decision-making, providing critical input on go/no-go recommendations. We value transparent communication, so you will be expected to flag risks early and candidly.
  • Ensure Data Integrity: Maintain rigorous, traceable records and structured data capture, ensuring your findings can be easily reviewed, reproduced, and built upon by the wider team.
  • Stay Ahead of the Curve: Keep a close pulse on the latest neurodegeneration literature and proactively bring relevant external developments to bear on our internal research programs.

Who You Are 

The level of the position will depend on the qualifications of the selected candidate.

Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

Core Expertise & Credentials

  • Neurodegeneration Specialist: You hold a Ph.D. in Neuroscience (or a related field) backed by 1+ years of post-doctoral or industry research experience focused on neurodegeneration.
  • Disease Biology Deep-Dive: You bring a robust understanding of neurodegenerative disease biology, including a nuanced perspective on the strengths and limitations of the rodent models used to study it.
  • Proven Track Record: You have an established publication record in the field and are accustomed to presenting your findings at conferences or similar scientific venues.

Technical & Experimental Capabilities

  • Hands-on Analyst: You have extensive, practical experience processing and analyzing both rodent and human brain tissue samples.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Therapeutic Fluency: You have experience working with therapeutic modalities relevant to the Central Nervous System (CNS), such as AAV-based approaches, ASOs, or small molecules.
  • Data-Driven Design: You possess strong quantitative and statistical judgment, enabling you to design appropriately powered studies, analyze complex data, and interpret results objectively without over-extrapolating.
  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.

Scientific Mindset & Adaptability

  • Fiercely Independent & Rigorous: You are highly self-directed—capable of defining a problem, selecting the right approach, and driving it to a conclusion with minimal oversight. You practice rigorous critical thinking and are always willing to interrogate your own data or change your position when the evidence warrants it.
  • Thrive in Dynamic Environments: You are comfortable and composed in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment where priorities can shift, decisions carry real weight, and quality must be sustained under pressure.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Cross-Functional Collaborator: You excel at working across disciplines and possess the strong communication skills needed to present complex technical datasets clearly to broad, mixed audiences.
  • Standard Bearer: You are enthusiastic about defining, implementing, and championing technical and cultural standards (like experimental rigor and reproducibility) across our scientific functions.

Preferred Qualifications, Knowledge, Skill and Abilities

  • In Vivo & Imaging: You have practical experience with animal surgeries, behavior, and vascular biology, and are proficient in imaging and behavioral analysis techniques.
  • Omics Interest: You have some exposure to analyzing biological datasets and a strong desire to build deep expertise in transcriptomics, proteomics, or spatial approaches.
  • Technical Foundations: You possess basic skills in bioinformatics data processing or programming (e.g., Python or R) and are eager to apply these to large-scale data management.
  • Human Cohort Awareness: You are interested in expanding your knowledge of working with human post-mortem or biopsy samples and the unique challenges of cohort-level data.
  • Technique Expansion: You are motivated to learn advanced imaging techniques, spatial biology, or high-content quantitative histology to enhance your research.
  • Collaborative Teamwork: You demonstrate strong potential for growth and a commitment to working effectively within a high-performing, collaborative team environment.
  • Clear Communicator: You are a clear and effective communicator, capable of presenting technical information to your peers and cross-functional partners.

title: Scientist- Delivery Sciences-targeted LNPs (tLNPs)
description:
Company info

NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan. We’re developing medicines to treat aging by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore youthful function in aged cells. We’ve built the world’s leading experimental and artificial intelligence system to discover reprogramming medicines at massive scale. Our first products are focused on restoring youthful metabolic, endothelial, and immune function.

Description

NewLimit is seeking a Scientist to design, formulate and characterize targeted LNPs (tLNPs) with antibody conjugates, Nanobodies, and scFv’s to build our targeting LNP platform with a particular focus on getting nucleic acid payloads into target cells and tissues beyond the liver.

This is a hands-on bench role with targeting compositional and reaction design ownership. You will work closely with the Delivery Sciences and biology teams to design and build relevant targeting lipids portfolio for New Limit’s pipeline programs.

What you’ll do

  • Design and develop LNP compositions and conjugation chemistries for antibodies, nanobodies, scFv’s, peptides, and other targeting moieties across multiple structural families, pushing the platform beyond current-generation materials for extra-hepatic targeting.
  • Plan conjugation reactions and purification for these modalities with scale and final purity in mind from the outset, delivering against agreed project timelines.
  • Test targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle.
  • Develop conjugation chemistries in-house or work with external partners to get the targeted LNPs for a particular target cell and build processes to support research teams to test the tLNPs in vivo.
  • Turn in vitro and in vivo data from discovery teams into concrete structural hypotheses and optimize the tLNP compositions or the type of targeting molecules used.
  • Present experimental results, and SAR conclusions, authoring protocols and technical reports.

Requirements

  • PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutical Chemistry and Biochemistry or a related discipline, plus 1–2 years of relevant work; or an MS with 5 years of focused tLNP design experience for liposomal or lipid nanoparticle applications.
  • Strong skill set in the design formulation of new targeted LNPs, performed personally rather than with a supervisor directing each step.
  • SAR-driven design, purification, and characterization of tLNPs and targeted moiety conjugated lipids and AI-based SAR prediction tools for tLNP applications.
  • Working knowledge of conjugation chemistries for attaching targeting moieties such as peptides, antibodies, nanobodies, and small-molecule ligands, including linker design and the selection of suitable biorthogonal or site-specific handles.
  • Practical purification skills spanning normal- and reverse-phase, size-exclusion chromatography and preparative HPLC.
  • Analytical characterization across LC-CAD, LC-UV, DLS, CE, bio-layer interferometry and surface plasmon resonance with the ability to deconvolute the data to produce well-characterized tLNPs.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with novel conjugation chemistries and reaction methods.
  • Targeting moiety optimization experience for Immune cells and endothelial cells.
  • Exposure to scale-up process development, CMC, or tech transfer to a CDMO.
  • Experience with data visualization and statistical analysis (R, Python, JMP)

Benefits

NewLimit provides generous benefits so our team can remain focused on our mission:

  • Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Industry-leading PTO: 20 days per year plus holidays.
  • On-site meals and snacks.

Salary Range: $130,000 to $171,000. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. NewLimit offers a competitive benefits package, which includes a 401k, healthcare coverage, and 20 days of PTO. title: Math Assessment Content Creator, Elementary School 3 - 5 (24 month Fixed Term)

description:
Notice to applicants:

We have seen a rise in recruitment scams. Please note that outreach from Khan Academy recruiters will only come from the @khanacademy.org domain. Our team does not use Gmail or other personal accounts for contacting potential candidates. Khan Academy will never solicit money, equipment fees, or sensitive financial information at any stage of the hiring process. We also do not work with external recruiting agencies, so outreach from headhunters presenting opportunities on behalf of Khan Academy is illegitimate. Please always check the email domain and cross-reference the position with the official Khan Academy Careers page to confirm an opening is valid.

ABOUT KHAN ACADEMY

Khan Academy is a nonprofit with the mission to deliver a free, world-class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers free, high-quality supplemental learning content and practice that cover Pre-K - 12th grade and early college core academic subjects, focusing on math and science. We have over 181 million registered learners globally and are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, focusing on learners in historically under-resourced communities.

OUR COMMUNITY 

Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, traditional/non-traditional education, big tech companies, and tiny startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in-house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world-class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.

THE ROLE

Khan Academy is seeking an experienced and versatile assessment content creator to serve as an Elementary Math Content Creator on the Assessments team.  This is a fixed-term position with an expected term of 24 months. As an assessment content creator, you will contribute to the development of new, innovative K-12 assessments. The ideal candidates will possess deep knowledge of 3 - 5 grade mathematics, state standards, and assessment development best practices, and have a passion for teaching and learning. 

Our math assessments content team of ES, MS and HS math content creators work closely together as a team to optimize standards coherence and alignment, and work cross-functionally with engineers, designers, and other teams at Khan Academy whose close collaboration is essential to delivering a high-quality, equitable, engaging  assessment experience for all learners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Contribute to the creation of K-12 assessments, leveraging your subject matter expertise to execute on blueprints to  create high-quality assessment content
  • Use and contribute to improvements in our content and item management systems
  • Ensure alignment of items with state standards and  item development best practices
  • Collaborate with teammates and cross-functional teams - product, design, and engineering -to create more engaging,  interactive, and informative assessments for our students 
  • Innovate with new item types made possible by AI technologies

WHAT YOU BRING

  • You are motivated by the Khan Academy mission “to provide a free world-class education for anyone, anywhere.”
  • Deep pedagogical expertise and expertise in state and national standards.
  • 2+ years classroom experience teaching elementary school mathematics.
  • A focus on assessment as a positive experience integrated with learning.
  • Experience with collaborative work on time-sensitive projects.
  • Interest in using new AI tools as assistants in content creation.
  • Experience in K-12 assessment development.
  • Excellent communication skills (oral and written), as well as an eye for detail. 
  • Excellent time management skills. 
  • Proven cross-cultural competency skills demonstrating self-awareness, awareness of others, and the ability to adopt inclusive perspectives, attitudes, and behaviors to drive inclusion and belonging throughout the organization.
  • A growth mindset that is curious and energized to innovate and create something new for our students. 
  • Project management skills (e.g. fluent with Google docs and spreadsheets and other tools) and a willingness to learn new tools
  • A bias to action. 
  • A passion for education and a desire to change the world
  • Nice to have: Middle School teaching and assessment experience

PERKS AND BENEFITS

We may be a non-profit, but we reward our talented team extremely well! We offer:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Ample paid time off as needed – Your well-being is a priority
  • 8 pre-scheduled Wellness Days in 2026 occurring on a Monday or a Friday for a 3-day weekend boost
  • Remote-first culture - that caters to your time zone, with open flexibility as needed, at times
  • Generous parental leave
  • An exceptional team that trusts you and gives you the freedom to do your best
  • The chance to put your talents towards a deeply meaningful mission and the opportunity to work on high-impact products that are already defining the future of education
  • Opportunities to connect through affinity, ally, and social groups
  • And we offer all those other typical benefits as well: 401(k) + 4% matching & comprehensive insurance, including medical, dental, vision, and life

At Khan Academy we are committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, the well-being of our employees, and our Khan community. This belief is why we have built out a robust Total Rewards package that includes competitive base salaries, and extensive benefits and perks to support physical, mental, and financial well-being.

 

The compensation band for this role is $77,600 - $87,300 USD annually for candidates based in the United States and $104,863 - $117,969 CAD annually for candidates based in Canada.

The pay range for this position is a general guideline only. The salary offered will depend on internal pay equity and the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, qualifications, and job market data. 

 

MORE ABOUT US

  • Sal’s TED talk from 2011
  • Sal’s TED talk from 2015
  • Sal's TED talk from 2023
  • Our team:  http://www.khanacademy.org/about/the-team

OUR COMPANY VALUES

Live & breathe learners

We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.

Take a stand

As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.

Embrace diverse perspectives

We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.

Work responsibly and sustainably

We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non-profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.

Bring out the joy

We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co-create with our teammates, partners and donors.

Cultivate learning mindset

We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.

Deliver wow

description:
Location: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

Shift: Monday-Friday, 7:30/8am start time

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer. 

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us. 

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Lab Automation Engineer at Foresight Diagnostics will be responsible for supporting the development and continuous improvement of Foresight’s laboratory automation function as well as providing first line support for troubleshooting methods in the CLIA lab. As the business life cycle evolves to vertically integrate manufacturing, this role will support the development and implementation with transition to the tech transfer functions within the organization. This position will collaborate cross functionally to deliver on business objectives with the intention of cross functional integration and operational scaling. This is a full-time position working 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM Monday to Friday, but may require the flexibility to work diverse schedules, including weekends, and holidays.  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Effectively deliver to project deadlines, on time and on budget, with adherence to applicable quality and regulatory requirements. 
  • Iterate on processes to drive continuous improvement with prioritization managed through the application/interpretation of KPI results. 
  • Collaborate with laboratory leads to align on automation requirements and develop workflows and instrument methods for laboratory optimization and software integration. 
  • Regularly perform preventative maintenance and inspections on Foresight’s automated systems to ensure reliable functionality. 
  • Execute major and minor repairs or coordinate with vendors for more complex repairs. 
  • Collaborate with Laboratory Operations to develop SOPs and training programs to enable successful tech transfer of new technology/workflows to the laboratory teams for production use. 
  • Work cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, and laboratory teams as necessary to properly forecast the number of automation instrumentation needed to meet volume demand, plan for and propose upgrades to the Foresight’s automation solution. 
  • As needed, perform maintenance to ensure operational capacity never impacts Foresight’s ability to successfully deliver on time results.  
  • Ensure effective resource utilization, planning and execution of people, process, and products in alignment with corporate objectives and volume projections across cross-functional teams. 
  • Implement laboratory processes that are compliant with appropriate regulations, to include but not limited to GxP, ISO, CFR, CAP/CLIA, NYSDOH. 
  • Guide troubleshooting and resolution of incident reports and CAPAs while driving continuous improvement

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years engineering experience supporting laboratory environments. 
  • A bachelor’s degree: BA/BS. An advanced degree, such as a Ph.D. or Masters degree preferred. 
  • Additional technical training would be a plus with an understanding of molecular biology and genomics. 
  • Working knowledge of liquid handling platforms such as Hamilton STAR line and Agilent Bravo preferred 
  • Proven ability to deliver actionable results to complex problems. 
  • Strong organizational skills with an understanding of scaling and capacity planning. 
  • Advanced analytical and operational skills with an ability to identify meaningful insights from complex data. 
  • Self-starter who thrives in ambiguity in a fast-paced environment. 
  • Ability to deliver on end-to-end projects with a high level of autonomy. 

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This position requires the individual to wear and work in personal protective equipment. 
  • This position requires that the individual is able to lift a minimum of 25lbs. 
  • Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers are required. 
  • The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures, writing and reviewing documents, and pipetting small volumes of clear liquids.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role 
Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Data domain. You will drive impactful product communication and champion customer success with our Clinical Data Management applications, Veeva EDC and Veeva DQS, partnering closely with our customers in India. You will also continuously grow your own expertise by staying at the absolute cutting edge of AI and digital transformation in clinical trials. To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
As part of the global Product Expert team, you will play a key role in the Product organization. Most importantly you will:
Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly engage with the customers in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value.
Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, and at industry events.
Drive increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion.
As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs, and industry-specific learnings, to our Product Management team based in the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Data products that enable: 
AI & Digital transformation
Risk-based decision making
Regulatory compliance
A culture of continuous improvement
Excellence across the pharmaceutical industry 
Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices, and Veeva Product success.
To apply for this role, you must have recent hands-on experience in either Veeva EDC or Veeva DQS.
 
 #LI-Remote #LI-MidSenior Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world. Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: Partner Development Manager, AI Partnerships
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Worldwide Alliances and Channels team develops and manages partnerships that help businesses adopt Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure. These partnerships create new routes to customers, extend the reach of Stripe’s Sales teams, and help Stripe and its partners serve shared customers.

The role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team. The team builds and executes joint go-to-market initiatives with major technology companies, with the goal of accelerating Stripe’s commercial growth.

As part of this team, you’ll lead global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, with an initial emphasis on leading AI labs. You’ll work across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, and regional partnerships teams to develop shared opportunities and turn them into scalable global partner strategies.

What you’ll do

As a Partner Development Manager, you’ll define and build Stripe’s global partnerships across the artificial intelligence ecosystem, initially focusing on leading AI labs. Although the role sits on the Americas Alliances and Channels Tech Partnerships team, its mandate is global. You’ll establish relationships across partner organizations, develop shared value propositions, and translate early opportunities into joint commercial and product initiatives.

This is an opportunity to build a new partnership motion from the ground up. You’ll start with focused opportunities, determine what works, and create a playbook that Stripe’s regional teams can apply around the world. Your work will span co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building.

Responsibilities

  • Build senior relationships across the commercial, partnerships, product, and technical organizations of Stripe’s priority AI partners
  • Develop and execute global partner strategies, including shared value propositions, joint business plans, success measures, and operating cadences
  • Identify and launch co-selling, co-marketing, and co-building initiatives that create value for Stripe, its partners, and shared customers
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams across Sales, Marketing, Product, Solutions Architecture, Legal, Finance, and regional partnerships
  • Work with Product and technical teams to identify opportunities for product collaboration and support productive technical conversations with partners
  • Create repeatable partnership playbooks that regional teams can adapt for local markets and AI ecosystems
  • Assess partnership performance, identify opportunities and risks, and communicate progress clearly to senior stakeholders

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 8 or more years of experience in strategic partnerships, partner development, business development, or a related commercial role within technology or another complex business-to-business environment
  • Experience building a strategic technology partnership from its early stages and translating the relationship into joint commercial, go-to-market, or product outcomes
  • Experience developing and executing joint go-to-market plans with external partners and cross-functional Sales, Marketing, Product, or technical teams
  • Experience building relationships with senior external stakeholders and leading global or distributed teams through influence
  • Bachelor’s degree and willingness to travel

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience managing partnerships with artificial intelligence companies, cloud providers, data platforms, developer platforms, or other global technology ecosystems
  • Understanding of the artificial intelligence and data value chain, including the commercial and technical considerations involved in building partner ecosystems
  • Experience across co-selling, co-marketing, and product or technical collaboration
  • Experience developing a partnership framework or playbook that was adopted across multiple regions or teams
  • Experience in payments, financial infrastructure, financial services, or commerce

title: Account Manager

As an Account Manager, you will own and grow a portfolio of high-value strategic accounts within the rapidly evolving AI infrastructure ecosystem. You will build trusted relationships with senior executives and technical decision-makers, helping organizations develop, deploy, and scale advanced AI solutions. Working closely with dedicated technical specialists, you will turn customer success into long-term commercial growth. Your focus will extend beyond retention to identifying new opportunities, expanding platform adoption, and negotiating complex, multi-year agreements. You will operate in a remote-first, fast-paced environment where autonomy, innovation, and accountability are highly valued. This is an opportunity to influence product direction, strengthen strategic partnerships, and contribute to the growth of a platform serving a global developer community. Accountabilities Manage a focused portfolio of fewer than 20 strategic enterprise accounts, taking ownership of customer relationships, retention, and revenue expansion. Establish high-touch engagement with executive stakeholders and technical teams through regular meetings, strategic account planning, and long-term growth initiatives. Collaborate closely with dedicated Forward Deployed Engineers to align technical achievements with customer objectives and commercial opportunities. Proactively introduce new platform capabilities, product developments, and innovative use cases to increase customer adoption, usage, and spending. Lead complex renewals and expansion opportunities, negotiating high-value, multi-year contracts, pricing structures, and service-level agreements. Build strong executive relationships and lead strategic business reviews focused on return on investment, roadmap alignment, business outcomes, and future capacity planning. Represent strategic customer needs internally, influencing product development, engineering priorities, and infrastructure planning. Maintain accurate account plans, forecasts, and customer health metrics, including net revenue retention (NRR), expansion revenue, churn risk, usage, and customer sentiment. Use CRM tools to track account performance, identify growth opportunities, and provide reliable reporting to leadership. Travel periodically to meet strategic customers and represent the business at relevant industry events. Requirements: At least 6 years of experience in account management, including a minimum of 2 years managing complex strategic accounts, ideally in AI infrastructure, GPU cloud, cloud computing, emerging cloud providers, or developer tooling. Proven success managing and expanding a concentrated portfolio of large, complex enterprise relationships, preferably involving multi-million-dollar contracts and $50 million or more in account value. Demonstrated experience negotiating multi-year renewals and expansion agreements worth seven to eight figures. Strong technical understanding and executive presence, with the ability to communicate credibly with developers, machine learning engineers, technical leaders, and C-suite decision-makers. A proactive, consultative approach to account management, with a demonstrated ability to identify growth opportunities, introduce innovative solutions, and drive commercial outcomes beyond day-to-day customer support. Experience working closely with technical teams to translate successful implementations and technical improvements into measurable revenue growth. Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills across business and technical audiences. Strong understanding of account performance metrics, including NRR, expansion revenue, churn, and product usage, combined with disciplined CRM management and accurate forecasting. Experience with HubSpot is an advantage. Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment where processes and strategies are continuously developed. Experience building account management processes or playbooks from the ground up is a plus. Willingness to travel periodically for customer meetings and industry events. Successful completion of a background check. Benefits: Competitive compensation: Target on-target earnings (OTE) of $160,000–$280,000 USD, converted to local currency, combining base salary and commission. The final package will depend on experience, qualifications, location, and role level. Uncapped commission: Earn beyond your target OTE through successful account expansion and revenue growth. Equity participation: Stock options that allow you to share in the long-term growth and success of the business. Healthcare coverage: Generous medical, dental, and vision plans. Flexible paid time off: Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance. Remote-first environment: Enjoy flexibility in where you work, supported by an inclusive and collaborative team culture. Home office support: A $1,200 stipend for home office equipment to help you create a productive workspace. Professional growth: Work at the forefront of AI infrastructure alongside a passionate team that values innovation, continuous learning, ownership, and meaningful impact. title: Editorial Researcher
description: Y Combinator is the leading startup accelerator for entrepreneurs. Since 2005, YC has invested in over 6,000 companies, including Airbnb, Dropbox, OpenAI, Stripe, Reddit, DoorDash, Coinbase, and Instacart. Today, YC has built the most powerful startup community in the world and is committed to supporting founders for the life of their company. Job Description: Y Combinator is looking for an Editorial Researcher to join the YC Media team. We make content for people who are curious about startups, technology, AI, science, and the future. That includes videos and podcasts, essays, original research, and new projects built around the enormous amount of knowledge and data that exists inside YC. We're looking for someone who is unusually curious, technically inclined, and a very good writer. You should be able to understand a complicated idea, figure out what's actually interesting about it, and explain it simply without dumbing it down. This isn't a traditional writing or editing job. You'll research stories, analyze data, develop ideas with YC partners and founders, help shape videos and podcasts, write and edit articles, and experiment with new kinds of editorial projects. What you'll do: Research, write, and edit YC’s written content. Develop ideas and do research for YC videos, podcasts, interviews, and other media. Work directly with YC partners, founders, and the rest of the Media team to turn interesting ideas into great content. Dig into data to find surprising trends about startups, technology, founders, and what people are building. Find interesting people, projects, papers, companies, and ideas before everyone else is talking about them. Help us figure out what YC should be covering and why. Take complicated technical subjects and make them clear, accurate, and interesting. Experiment with new editorial formats and ways of telling stories. You might be a good fit if: You're deeply curious about technology and understand the culture around startups, AI, engineering, and the internet. You're an excellent writer and editor. You can make complicated things simple without making them simplistic. You're technical enough to talk to engineers and researchers and understand what they're actually saying. You like going down rabbit holes, reading papers, digging through datasets, talking to experts, and figuring things out for yourself. You have strong editorial judgment. You can recognize when something is genuinely interesting rather than merely popular. You're comfortable working across formats. An idea might become a Substack post, a YouTube video, a podcast conversation, a chart, or something we haven't tried yet. You're opinionated about media and the internet and have good instincts about what smart people actually want to read and watch. You don't need someone to hand you a story. You find them. There isn't one obvious background for this role. You might be an engineer who loves writing, someone from developer relations, a technical journalist, a data journalist, a researcher, a former founder, or someone who has worked at a think tank. We're much more interested in how you think, how you write, and what you've made than what your previous title was. Above all, we're looking for someone who is smart, curious, technically adventurous, and wants to make things that smart people genuinely want to read and watch. Location: YC is headquartered in San Francisco, and candidates must reside in the San Francisco Bay Area. Our Media Team works from our Dogpatch offices in San Francisco at least three days per week, with additional in-office days as filming schedules require. Some projects may also require travel and weekend work. Compensation : $180,000-$200,000 salary (depending on skills and experience). Benefits : Our full benefits package includes medical, vision, and dental plans, an infertility benefit, STD/LTD, life insurance, commuter benefits, a flexible spending account, a health savings account, a 401(k) with 4% matching, generous parental leave, paid holidays, and a flexible paid time off policy. Work Authorization: This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship. Y Combinator considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law, including San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance. Y Combinator is committed to protecting the privacy of job applicants' personal information and to complying with the California Consumer Privacy Act. The privacy policy of Ashby, Inc., the hiring platform used by Y Combinator, governs the collection of such data and is available here .

title: Data Scientist
description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the Team Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies. We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world. About the role: As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks. This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others. What you'll be doing: Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies. Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges. Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise. Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints. Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments. Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks. Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects. Who we're looking for: You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms. You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty. You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks. You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards. You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines. You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI. Our Interview Process Talent Team Screen (30 minutes) Take Home Technical Assessment Technical Interview (90 minutes) Commercial Interview (60 minutes) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary: 

Real Chemistry is looking for a Manager, Paid Social to join our growing team! 

The Manager, Paid Social is responsible for social campaign paid planning, strategy, execution, implementation, and delivery to meet client objectives. 

You’ll be the day-to-day partner to strategy & account teams and will leverage your knowledge of paid social media to support strategy development and delivery. You will activate omni-channel, digital first marketing and advertising campaigns for our clients, leveraging your capabilities in managing paid social media, dynamic ad creative, personalization, and integrated digital media programs. 

This is a hybrid role, based in any of our US offices—including New York City, Boston, Chicago, Carmel, Lambertville, or San Francisco—or remotely within the US, depending on team and business needs. 

 

What you’ll do: 

  • Collaborate with internal team and client peers to support strategic solutions that respond to business and communications challenges with healthcare professionals, patients, and caregivers 
  • Act as day-to-day paid social media lead across several healthcare accounts, but part of an integrated team; responsible for the execution of social media campaign planning, setup, creation, QA, optimization, performance, and management  
  • Cultivate and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of social media platforms and trends to guide account teams and help Real Chemistry continue to be a leader in the space 
  • Create and help present thoughtful, clear, concise decks that translate business objectives and strategies into tangible media plans that achieve business goals 
  • Provide counsel and guidance internally and with client on guiding creative and placement optimizations as well as best practices for incorporating paid social into an overall social strategy 
  • Provide strong input on KPIs for program success and performance data, partnering with analytics teams on building measurement approaches that deliver on KPI’s and goals 
  • Support financial processes; monitor budgets in ad platforms, maintain flowcharts, review and approve campaigns in MediaOcean/Prisma 
  • Provide proactive recommendations on research findings, campaign results, industry trends and innovation, competitive pressures to keep clients informed and manage programs upon best practices of paid social media 
  • Ability to understand key metrics and utilize data and analytics to inform trading strategies and campaign management approach 
  • Build close partnerships with media partners and understand the ecosystem from demand, supply, verification, measurement etc. 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if: 

  • Our Company values, Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I", genuinely resonate with how you work and lead. 
  • You demonstrate the Real Chemistry Can mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities. 
  • You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.  
  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.  
  • You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact. 

 

What you should have: 

  • 1-3 years of experience managing paid social media and being a hands-on trader, managing a client’s performance marketing/advertising-driven activities across multiple social platforms 
  • Preference for experience in pharma/healthcare industry, but not required - must have strong knowledge of the platforms and data used to support and measure the overall performance of the campaign 
  • Proficiency with social media buying platforms: Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Reddit Ads, X Ads etc. - Meta Blueprint, X Ads Academy/Twitter Flight School and Google Certifications a plus  
  • Display an in-depth understanding of the functionality, strategies behind social media driven campaigns and best practices of all major social platforms 
  • Exceptional project management skills: demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines, prioritize and manage detailed budgets 
  • Ability to work well under pressure and to build relationships with internal teams 
  • Work related diversity, equity and inclusion involvement a plus

  • Partnering with UA and growth teams to test hypotheses and scale what performs

  • Spotting patterns, trends, and cultural moments to inform future campaigns

What success looks like
